phases.name: Validate Core Assumptions
actions: Partner with a local charging‑swap provider to set up 2 pilot swap stations covering a 5 km radius.
Deploy 20 scooters to a test cohort of 18‑35‑year‑old commuters with smartphones.
Track monthly charging‑swap cost per scooter and ensure it stays ≤ INR 500.
Complete standard two‑wheel registration for each scooter within 30 days of delivery.
phases.gate: Go if average swap cost ≤ INR 500 and 100% of scooters are registered within 30 days.
risks_addressed: Charging‑swap cost may exceed target (must stay ≤ INR 1500 total).
Regulatory compliance risk for registration timing.

phases.name: Pilot Subscription Model
actions: Launch a 3‑month subscription to the 20‑scooter pilot cohort at INR 2,500 per month.
Monitor churn, average daily rides, and payment success rate.
Negotiate a formal agreement with the charging‑swap partner to lock in ≤ INR 1,500 per scooter per month total cost.
Engage local traffic authority to confirm subscription scooters receive same registration/parking treatment as private two‑wheelers.
phases.gate: Go if churn < 15%, payment success ≥ 95%, and authority confirms equal treatment.

phases.name: Scale Preparation
actions: Secure contracts with 3 additional charging‑swap partners to cover 5 km zones city‑wide.
Finalize SOPs for routine maintenance targeting ≤ INR 500 per scooter per month.
Build a digital onboarding flow confirming smartphone ownership and digital‑payment capability.
Create a compliance checklist confirming registration within 30 days for all fleet units.
phases.gate: Go if cost model shows ≤ INR 1,500 total monthly cost per scooter and compliance checklist passes 100%.

phases.name: Full Launch
actions: Deploy 1,000 scooters across Bengaluru with partnered swap stations.
Roll out subscription plans with tiered pricing based on pilot insights.
Monitor key KPIs: cost per scooter, registration compliance, churn, and market share.
Report to investors and consider SoftBank follow‑on funding if > 5% market share achieved.
phases.gate: Go if average cost ≤ INR 1,500, registration compliance 100%, churn < 15%, and market share ≥ 5% after 6 months.

plan.first_step: Run a low‑cost pilot to validate charging‑swap cost and registration compliance.
